text:
Across the bridges of Zamora,

alone and slow, went my soul.


Not across the iron bridge;

the stone one was the one it loved.


At times it looked at the sky,

at times it looked at the water.


Across the bridges of Zamora,

alone and slow, went my soul.

translation.title: Song Five
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the simple refrain and the preference for the stone bridge.
